source: DATA_MODEL §6 (app.purposes); BUILD_PLAN §13 (DPDP by construction, retention proposal for lawyer review).
notes: Every consent row (app.consents, C-MMDD-NN) names one purpose. A buyer's number reaches a party only through number_share, created by the buyer's own tap.
notice_section is the anchor of the purpose in the privacy notice; the notice text is versioned in app.notice_versions.

retention_classes.kept: For the life of the account; erased within 30 days of an erasure request, with legal-hold exceptions.
Life of the account + 3 years, as proof of consent.
12 months after the buyer ends a relay or a share.
24 months after last activity, then anonymised.
Redacted output 12 months; the input hash is kept.
Pseudonymous ids only, under analytics consent; deleted with the account.

purposes.description: Run your account: sign-in by phone code, your follows, saved cost sheets and settings.
Send the utility alerts and digests you turned on, by push, WhatsApp or email.
Send a relative who joined your circle the same alerts for the projects you shared. They never see your number.
Give a site office your first name, the visit time and only the questions you chose to send ahead, with a relay instead of your number.
Send a developer's office only the enquiry fields you ticked, with a relay instead of your number.
Brief the agent you chose with the fields you picked; other fields read "Not shared".
Share your phone number with one party, by your own tap. At most 3 parties in any 30 days.
Measure how pages are used, with pseudonymous ids. No session replay on account pages.
Read your uploads and questions with an AI model, after phones, PAN, Aadhaar and emails are removed.
